extraction.body: Apple unveils groundbreaking MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and Touch for the first time on Mac The world’s best pro laptop now features an industry-leading tandem OLED display, an intuitive Touch experience, blazing-fast M5 Pro and M5 Max performance and AI capabilities, and up to 24 hours of battery life, all in a thinner, lighter design CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced the all-new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display , featuring breakthrough tandem OLED technology that delivers game-changing front-of-screen performance. Available in 14- and 16-inch models, MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display offers a visual experience unlike any other, transforming pro workflows with up to 2000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness, an industry-leading 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio for exceptional detail, a 120Hz variable refresh rate, and a wider color gamut covering both P3 and Adobe RGB for brilliant colors. The new MacBook Pro also introduces intuitive Touch capabilities on the Mac for the first time, opening up a whole new dimension for pros to interact with their content, from manipulating 3D models to playing musical instruments onscreen. The Dynamic Island now comes to Mac, serving as the home for Spotlight, 1 Live Activities, and Siri AI. 2 And with up to 24 hours of battery life in thinner and much lighter 3- and 4-pound designs, MacBook Pro is more portable than ever, empowering pros to take their work wherever inspiration strikes. 3 Featuring M5 Pro and M5 Max, Apple’s most powerful chips ever built for a pro laptop, along with up to 128GB of unified memory and now up to 16TB of blazing-fast storage, the new MacBook Pro delivers speed and capability for the most demanding workflows. An enhanced six-speaker sound system now provides 50 percent deeper bass and remarkable sound clarity for even more immersive audio. And Thunderbolt 5 and a wide array of connectivity, a 12MP Center Stage camera, studio-quality mics, and the power of macOS 27 with Apple Intelligence and Siri AI complete the MacBook Pro experience. 2 It is available to pre-order starting today, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6. “The new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is a monumental step forward for the Mac,” said Johny Srouji, Apple’s chief hardware officer. “PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display. It pairs state-of-the-art tandem OLED technology with advanced algorithms in our display engine to deliver the kind of visual fidelity pros have been dreaming of. And with the magic of Touch coming to MacBook Pro, combined with the game-changing performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, we’ve created a whole new way for pros to interact with their content, taking their workflows to a completely new level. The new MacBook Pro is the result of the deep integration between Apple silicon, hardware, and software, and there’s simply nothing else like it.” PROLED XDR: The World’s Best Display in a Pro Laptop The new MacBook Pro debuts the PROLED XDR display, which uses tandem OLED technology and advances it with breakthrough innovations in every layer, advanced algorithms in the display engine, and a state-of-the-art factory calibration process to deliver Extreme Dynamic Range (XDR) and stunning visual fidelity. With exceptional brightness, striking contrast, and vivid true-to-life colors, PROLED XDR offers the ultimate front-of-screen performance, enabling a new level of visual acuity and precision for content creators, photographers, colorists, and designers who need a reference-caliber display on the go. PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display, delivering true-to-life color and unparalleled brightness and contrast. The PROLED XDR display offers tandem OLED technology unlike any other, with deep innovations in its layers that keep brightness and grayscale uniform across the entire display, while minimizing internal reflections common in traditional OLED designs. It’s all backed by advanced algorithms in the display engine that precisely control each pixel in real time, plus a meticulous manufacturing process and precise calibration of every panel for consistency from display to display. PROLED XDR offers up to 2000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness, allowing specular highlights to shine with stunning intensity. And through optimizations in the tandem OLED panel and custom compensation techniques, combined with precise control of light across the display, the PROLED XDR display achieves an industry-leading 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio, so even the deepest shadows reveal incredible detail, bringing HDR content remarkably close to reality. The Ultimate Display for Color-Critical Workflows PROLED XDR offers pros a super-wide color gamut with P3 and now Adobe RGB — critical for workflows in photography and design — along with notably wider coverage in green and cyan ranges. This results in more than 80 percent Rec. 2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading. Cutting-edge factory calibration ensures luminance, white point, and color gamut are precisely aligned with standard targets. Both color spaces are accessible within a single default preset, streamlining pro workflows and making it seamless to switch between them. With the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, pros have a portable reference display on the go. With up to 2000 nits peak SDR brightness, combined with a state-of-the-art antireflective coating, the display is easy to read even in bright lighting conditions. For even greater visibility, the nano-texture option — now precisely etched into the cover glass — further reduces reflections and glare to eliminate distractions while maintaining an excellent viewing experience. With breakthrough tandem OLED technology, extreme brightness, and extraordinary contrast, along with a super-wide color gamut, PROLED XDR is truly the world’s best laptop display, giving pros an unparalleled visual experience and setting a whole new bar for the industry. MacBook Pro features Touch for the first time, bringing pros a whole new way to interact with their content. Crafted specifically for the Mac, every touch interaction feels incredibly responsive and refined. Everyday tasks are simple and intuitive, allowing users to scroll through a webpage with a natural swipe; pinch to zoom in on a photo; drag and drop slides from one presentation to another; and double-tap a window to fill the screen, or flick to tile it into place. And the touch sensor is built directly into the display panel — not layered on top of it — reducing latency so users feel like they’re touching the content itself. Touch also introduces entirely new ways of working for pro users. Graphic designers can now use the entire display as their canvas, no longer constrained by the area of the trackpad when drawing; musicians can play software instruments right onscreen; and app developers can test how Touch performs in their iOS and iPadOS apps directly on the MacBook Pro display. And these new ways to interact with MacBook Pro work in tandem with the keyboard shortcuts and trackpad gestures pros know and love. In addition, a newly designed hinge provides greater stability while using Touch, and advanced video stabilization automatically smooths the camera feed in real time while using Touch on a video call. Apple apps are optimized for the new MacBook Pro, and many existing apps work with Touch right away, because macOS automatically translates touches into clicks. Updated system gesture APIs also enable developers to create intuitive experiences designed specifically for Touch. And a wide range of third-party apps that pros rely on every day will also take advantage of Touch on the new MacBook Pro, bringing new ways to interact with their favorite tools and workflows. These include everyday productivity and collaboration apps like Notion, Canva, Zoom, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook; powerful creative tools for photo and video editing like Adobe Lightroom and DaVinci Resolve; 3D modeling and animation apps like Blender, Maxon Cinema 4D, Maxon ZBrush, and Shapr3D; along with music apps like Algoriddim djay Pro. 4 The Dynamic Island comes to the Mac, serving as the new home for Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI, where users can quickly search for anything on their MacBook Pro, access real-time updates, or take advantage of Siri AI. 1 Just like on iPhone, the Dynamic Island provides a quick, intuitive way to see and interact with important information. Users can ask a question, pick up a phone call, or control music — all within easy reach. With Live Activities, users can now get timely updates at a glance, and can accept an AirDrop request or pause a song with a tap of their finger. The new MacBook Pro is thinner and significantly lighter for even better portability. The 14-inch MacBook Pro now weighs half a pound less at 3 pounds, while the 16-inch MacBook Pro weighs just 4 pounds — 0.7 pounds lighter than before. 5 Both models feature a slimmer design enabled by OLED’s more efficient display stack, with the 16-inch model nearly a millimeter thinner and the 14-inch model half a millimeter thinner. With slimmer display borders, the 16-inch display grows to 16.3 inches, while the 14-inch display delivers a more portable 14.2-inch design. 6 And a completely redesigned thermal architecture enables the same incredible sustained performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, even in a lighter design, while redirecting warm air away from the display. M5 Pro and M5 Max: Game‑Changing Pro Performance and On-Device AI The new MacBook Pro features M5 Pro and M5 Max, Apple’s most powerful chips ever built for a pro laptop. Both deliver phenomenal single- and multithreaded CPU performance, along with faster unified memory, giving users blazing speed for the most demanding workflows. M5 Pro offers game-changing performance for scientists, engineers, software developers, and creative pros tackling intensive projects, accelerating everything from compiling code and running AI tasks to sequencing DNA and editing multiple streams of 8K ProRes video. M5 Max is built for users who want to push the limits even further, including 3D VFX artists, AI developers, and film composers. With M5 Max, pros can run LLMs with hundreds of billions of parameters entirely on device and accelerate intense workflows across detailed visual effects, 3D animation projects, film scores, and 8K video post-production. A powerful Neural Accelerator built into each GPU core lets users speed through AI workloads like running a coding agent with an on-device LLM. And users are able to power through advanced graphics-intensive tasks like rendering a complex scene in Cinema 4D with Redshift. M5 Pro and M5 Max each feature a GPU with enhanced shader cores and a third-generation ray-tracing engine, delivering more photorealistic lighting and faster renders for 3D modeling. Dynamic Caching optimizes on-chip memory to significantly increase GPU utilization, driving huge performance boosts for apps like Blender and Unreal Engine, along with AAA games. The industry-leading six-speaker audio system in the new MacBook Pro features an all-new woofer design that provides 50 percent deeper bass and all-new tweeters that shape sound dispersion for remarkable clarity. Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos wraps users in immersive sound for music and movies, and studio-quality mics deliver clean, clear audio for calls, recordings, and voice commands. And for the first time, dedicated audio tuning for closed-lid use delivers exceptional sound quality when MacBook Pro is connected to an external display, so users can enjoy a premium audio experience however they work. The new MacBook Pro packs features for the most demanding users. The PROLED XDR display offers calibration and industry-standard reference modes in a portable form factor, making MacBook Pro an indispensable tool for filmmaking, design, and even medical imaging. 7 And macOS makes the most of the graphics, memory, and machine learning capabilities of Apple silicon, so apps perform at incredible speed. The new MacBook Pro includes three Thunderbolt 5 ports, HDMI, an SDXC card slot, MagSafe, and a headphone jack. In addition to the PROLED XDR display, it supports up to three external displays with M5 Pro and up to four with M5 Max. Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 provide fast, reliable wireless connectivity, and Touch ID enables a quick, easy, and secure login experience. With its fast-charge capability, MacBook Pro can charge up to 50 percent in just 30 minutes. 3 In addition, storage is now configurable up to 16TB. The new MacBook Pro comes to life with macOS 27. In addition to Touch built for macOS 27, MacBook Pro includes Siri AI, a profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal assistant; helpful Apple Intelligence features across apps; and an expansive set of improvements that make the Mac even more responsive and reliable. Siri AI can draw on personal context to help pros find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps — all with groundbreaking privacy protections. Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what’s on their display with Visual Intelligence by using a dedicated keyboard shortcut to get help with a specific item. Pros can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type. Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful. In Safari, it powers new tools that automatically organize a user’s tabs into topics; notify them of website changes, like product restocks or price drops; and enable the creation of custom extensions based on a description. Pros can also easily create an automation in Shortcuts by simply describing it, or tap into intelligent photo editing tools in the Photos app. Features users already rely on get even better with improvements to performance and search. Refinements to Liquid Glass deliver an even more focused and approachable experience. A new slider in Settings gives users the option to personalize Liquid Glass, adjusting it anywhere from ultraclear to fully tinted to match their preference, and app icons are sharper and more defined. MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and the Environment The new MacBook Pro was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 55 percent recycled content overall, 9 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure, 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery, and, in a first for Apple, 100 percent recycled tantalum in multiple capacitors. passages: Apple unveils groundbreaking MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and Touch for the first time on Mac

The world’s best pro laptop now features an industry-leading tandem OLED display, an intuitive Touch experience, blazing-fast M5 Pro and M5 Max performance and AI capabilities, and up to 24 hours of battery life, all in a thinner, lighter design

CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced the all-new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display , featuring breakthrough tandem OLED technology that delivers game-changing front-of-screen performance. Available in 14- and 16-inch models, MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display offers a visual experience unlike any other, transforming pro workflows with up to 2000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness, an industry-leading 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio for exceptional detail, a 120Hz variable refresh rate, and a wider color gamut covering both P3 and Adobe RGB for brilliant colors. The new MacBook Pro also introduces intuitive Touch capabilities on the Mac for the first time, opening up a whole new dimension for pros to interact with their content, from manipulating 3D models to playing musical instruments onscreen. The Dynamic Island now comes to Mac, serving as the home for Spotlight, 1 Live Activities, and Siri AI. 2 And with up to 24 hours of battery life in thinner and much lighter 3- and 4-pound designs, MacBook Pro is more portable than ever, empowering pros to take their work wherever inspiration strikes. 3 Featuring M5 Pro and M5 Max, Apple’s most powerful chips ever built for a pro laptop, along with up to 128GB of unified memory and now up to 16TB of blazing-fast storage, the new MacBook Pro delivers speed and capability for the most demanding workflows. An enhanced six-speaker sound system now provides 50 percent deeper bass and remarkable sound clarity for even more immersive audio. And Thunderbolt 5 and a wide array of connectivity, a 12MP Center Stage camera, studio-quality mics, and the power of macOS 27 with Apple Intelligence and Siri AI complete the MacBook Pro experience. 2 It is available to pre-order starting today, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.

“The new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is a monumental step forward for the Mac,” said Johny Srouji, Apple’s chief hardware officer. “PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display. It pairs state-of-the-art tandem OLED technology with advanced algorithms in our display engine to deliver the kind of visual fidelity pros have been dreaming of. And with the magic of Touch coming to MacBook Pro, combined with the game-changing performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, we’ve created a whole new way for pros to interact with their content, taking their workflows to a completely new level. The new MacBook Pro is the result of the deep integration between Apple silicon, hardware, and software, and there’s simply nothing else like it.”
PROLED XDR: The World’s Best Display in a Pro Laptop

The new MacBook Pro debuts the PROLED XDR display, which uses tandem OLED technology and advances it with breakthrough innovations in every layer, advanced algorithms in the display engine, and a state-of-the-art factory calibration process to deliver Extreme Dynamic Range (XDR) and stunning visual fidelity. With exceptional brightness, striking contrast, and vivid true-to-life colors, PROLED XDR offers the ultimate front-of-screen performance, enabling a new level of visual acuity and precision for content creators, photographers, colorists, and designers who need a reference-caliber display on the go.

PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display, delivering true-to-life color and unparalleled brightness and contrast. The PROLED XDR display offers tandem OLED technology unlike any other, with deep innovations in its layers that keep brightness and grayscale uniform across the entire display, while minimizing internal reflections common in traditional OLED designs. It’s all backed by advanced algorithms in the display engine that precisely control each pixel in real time, plus a meticulous manufacturing process and precise calibration of every panel for consistency from display to display.

PROLED XDR offers up to 2000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness, allowing specular highlights to shine with stunning intensity. And through optimizations in the tandem OLED panel and custom compensation techniques, combined with precise control of light across the display, the PROLED XDR display achieves an industry-leading 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio, so even the deepest shadows reveal incredible detail, bringing HDR content remarkably close to reality.
The Ultimate Display for Color-Critical Workflows

PROLED XDR offers pros a super-wide color gamut with P3 and now Adobe RGB — critical for workflows in photography and design — along with notably wider coverage in green and cyan ranges. This results in more than 80 percent Rec. 2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading. Cutting-edge factory calibration ensures luminance, white point, and color gamut are precisely aligned with standard targets. Both color spaces are accessible within a single default preset, streamlining pro workflows and making it seamless to switch between them. With the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, pros have a portable reference display on the go.

With up to 2000 nits peak SDR brightness, combined with a state-of-the-art antireflective coating, the display is easy to read even in bright lighting conditions. For even greater visibility, the nano-texture option — now precisely etched into the cover glass — further reduces reflections and glare to eliminate distractions while maintaining an excellent viewing experience.

With breakthrough tandem OLED technology, extreme brightness, and extraordinary contrast, along with a super-wide color gamut, PROLED XDR is truly the world’s best laptop display, giving pros an unparalleled visual experience and setting a whole new bar for the industry.

MacBook Pro features Touch for the first time, bringing pros a whole new way to interact with their content. Crafted specifically for the Mac, every touch interaction feels incredibly responsive and refined. Everyday tasks are simple and intuitive, allowing users to scroll through a webpage with a natural swipe; pinch to zoom in on a photo; drag and drop slides from one presentation to another; and double-tap a window to fill the screen, or flick to tile it into place. And the touch sensor is built directly into the display panel — not layered on top of it — reducing latency so users feel like they’re touching the content itself.

Touch also introduces entirely new ways of working for pro users. Graphic designers can now use the entire display as their canvas, no longer constrained by the area of the trackpad when drawing; musicians can play software instruments right onscreen; and app developers can test how Touch performs in their iOS and iPadOS apps directly on the MacBook Pro display. And these new ways to interact with MacBook Pro work in tandem with the keyboard shortcuts and trackpad gestures pros know and love. In addition, a newly designed hinge provides greater stability while using Touch, and advanced video stabilization automatically smooths the camera feed in real time while using Touch on a video call.

Apple apps are optimized for the new MacBook Pro, and many existing apps work with Touch right away, because macOS automatically translates touches into clicks. Updated system gesture APIs also enable developers to create intuitive experiences designed specifically for Touch. And a wide range of third-party apps that pros rely on every day will also take advantage of Touch on the new MacBook Pro, bringing new ways to interact with their favorite tools and workflows. These include everyday productivity and collaboration apps like Notion, Canva, Zoom, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook; powerful creative tools for photo and video editing like Adobe Lightroom and DaVinci Resolve; 3D modeling and animation apps like Blender, Maxon Cinema 4D, Maxon ZBrush, and Shapr3D; along with music apps like Algoriddim djay Pro. 4

The Dynamic Island comes to the Mac, serving as the new home for Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI, where users can quickly search for anything on their MacBook Pro, access real-time updates, or take advantage of Siri AI. 1 Just like on iPhone, the Dynamic Island provides a quick, intuitive way to see and interact with important information. Users can ask a question, pick up a phone call, or control music — all within easy reach. With Live Activities, users can now get timely updates at a glance, and can accept an AirDrop request or pause a song with a tap of their finger.

The new MacBook Pro is thinner and significantly lighter for even better portability. The 14-inch MacBook Pro now weighs half a pound less at 3 pounds, while the 16-inch MacBook Pro weighs just 4 pounds — 0.7 pounds lighter than before. 5 Both models feature a slimmer design enabled by OLED’s more efficient display stack, with the 16-inch model nearly a millimeter thinner and the 14-inch model half a millimeter thinner.

With slimmer display borders, the 16-inch display grows to 16.3 inches, while the 14-inch display delivers a more portable 14.2-inch design. 6 And a completely redesigned thermal architecture enables the same incredible sustained performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, even in a lighter design, while redirecting warm air away from the display.
M5 Pro and M5 Max: Game‑Changing Pro Performance and On-Device AI

The new MacBook Pro features M5 Pro and M5 Max, Apple’s most powerful chips ever built for a pro laptop. Both deliver phenomenal single- and multithreaded CPU performance, along with faster unified memory, giving users blazing speed for the most demanding workflows. M5 Pro offers game-changing performance for scientists, engineers, software developers, and creative pros tackling intensive projects, accelerating everything from compiling code and running AI tasks to sequencing DNA and editing multiple streams of 8K ProRes video. M5 Max is built for users who want to push the limits even further, including 3D VFX artists, AI developers, and film composers. With M5 Max, pros can run LLMs with hundreds of billions of parameters entirely on device and accelerate intense workflows across detailed visual effects, 3D animation projects, film scores, and 8K video post-production.

A powerful Neural Accelerator built into each GPU core lets users speed through AI workloads like running a coding agent with an on-device LLM. And users are able to power through advanced graphics-intensive tasks like rendering a complex scene in Cinema 4D with Redshift. M5 Pro and M5 Max each feature a GPU with enhanced shader cores and a third-generation ray-tracing engine, delivering more photorealistic lighting and faster renders for 3D modeling. Dynamic Caching optimizes on-chip memory to significantly increase GPU utilization, driving huge performance boosts for apps like Blender and Unreal Engine, along with AAA games.

The industry-leading six-speaker audio system in the new MacBook Pro features an all-new woofer design that provides 50 percent deeper bass and all-new tweeters that shape sound dispersion for remarkable clarity. Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos wraps users in immersive sound for music and movies, and studio-quality mics deliver clean, clear audio for calls, recordings, and voice commands. And for the first time, dedicated audio tuning for closed-lid use delivers exceptional sound quality when MacBook Pro is connected to an external display, so users can enjoy a premium audio experience however they work.

The new MacBook Pro packs features for the most demanding users. The PROLED XDR display offers calibration and industry-standard reference modes in a portable form factor, making MacBook Pro an indispensable tool for filmmaking, design, and even medical imaging. 7 And macOS makes the most of the graphics, memory, and machine learning capabilities of Apple silicon, so apps perform at incredible speed.

The new MacBook Pro includes three Thunderbolt 5 ports, HDMI, an SDXC card slot, MagSafe, and a headphone jack. In addition to the PROLED XDR display, it supports up to three external displays with M5 Pro and up to four with M5 Max. Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 provide fast, reliable wireless connectivity, and Touch ID enables a quick, easy, and secure login experience. With its fast-charge capability, MacBook Pro can charge up to 50 percent in just 30 minutes. 3 In addition, storage is now configurable up to 16TB.

The new MacBook Pro comes to life with macOS 27. In addition to Touch built for macOS 27, MacBook Pro includes Siri AI, a profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal assistant; helpful Apple Intelligence features across apps; and an expansive set of improvements that make the Mac even more responsive and reliable. Siri AI can draw on personal context to help pros find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps — all with groundbreaking privacy protections. Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what’s on their display with Visual Intelligence by using a dedicated keyboard shortcut to get help with a specific item. Pros can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type.

Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful. In Safari, it powers new tools that automatically organize a user’s tabs into topics; notify them of website changes, like product restocks or price drops; and enable the creation of custom extensions based on a description. Pros can also easily create an automation in Shortcuts by simply describing it, or tap into intelligent photo editing tools in the Photos app. Features users already rely on get even better with improvements to performance and search. Refinements to Liquid Glass deliver an even more focused and approachable experience. A new slider in Settings gives users the option to personalize Liquid Glass, adjusting it anywhere from ultraclear to fully tinted to match their preference, and app icons are sharper and more defined.
MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and the Environment

The new MacBook Pro was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 55 percent recycled content overall, 9 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure, 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery, and, in a first for Apple, 100 percent recycled tantalum in multiple capacitors. It is manufactured with 45 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain. The new MacBook Pro is designed to be durable and repairable, and meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 10 and designed to be recycled.

Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984. Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro. Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV. Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.

passages: The 14-inch MacBook Pro with Apple’s PROLED XDR tandem OLED display starts at $2,899 in the US, according to MacRumors , and ships from Friday 6 November 2026.
Apple announced the laptop in a press release on 28 October 2026 and said it brings Touch to the Mac for the first time.
Thinner display borders take the screens to 14.2 and 16.3 inches.
The M5 Pro version drives up to three external displays and the M5 Max up to four.
Fast charging takes the battery to 50 per cent in 30 minutes, and the six-speaker sound system has a new woofer design that Apple said gives 50 per cent deeper bass.
Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 run on an Apple-designed N1 wireless chip.
The panel covers both the P3 and Adobe RGB colour spaces, with more than 80 per cent coverage of Rec.
A nano-texture option etched into the cover glass cuts reflections and glare.
Apple said the display reaches up to 2000 nits of peak brightness for HDR and SDR content, a 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio and a refresh rate that varies between 10Hz and 120Hz.
Users can scroll a webpage with a swipe, pinch to zoom in on a photo, drag slides from one presentation to another and double-tap a window to fill the screen.
macOS translates touches into clicks, so many existing apps work with Touch at launch, Apple said.

Pixelmator Pro, Logic Pro and Final Cut Pro gain Touch controls through Apple Creator Studio.
Apple said a redesigned hinge adds stability when the screen is touched, and video stabilisation smooths the camera feed when Touch is used during a video call.
The laptops run macOS 27 with Apple Intelligence and Siri AI.

extraction.body: On October 28, 2026, Apple unveiled the MacBook Pro with a PROLED XDR display, the first Mac ever to feature a touchscreen. The new tandem OLED panel replaces the previous Mini-LED display, offering up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness and a contrast ratio of 10,000,000:1. Featuring the M5 Pro or M5 Max, Dynamic Island, and up to 24 hours of battery life, the device goes on sale starting November 6, with prices in the U.S. starting at $2,899. With PROLED XDR, Apple is introducing a new designation for the displays on its Pro laptops. Technically, it’s a tandem OLED panel: Two stacked light-emitting layers work together to produce greater brightness and more uniform illumination than a single OLED panel could achieve. Apple cites up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness in SDR and HDR, as well as a contrast ratio of 10,000,000:1. By comparison, the previous Liquid Retina XDR display with Mini-LED backlighting achieved 1,600 nits of peak HDR brightness and a contrast ratio of 1,000,000:1. In addition, there is a wider color gamut that now covers Adobe RGB in addition to P3; both color spaces are included in a single preset profile. For video professionals, the Rec. 2020 coverage of over 80 percent is likely to be of particular interest. The variable refresh rate ranges from 10 to 120 Hz; depending on the content, the system automatically switches between power-saving mode and smooth display. Anti-glare nano-textured glass remains available as an optional extra. 42 years after the introduction of the first Macintosh, Apple is bringing touch control to a Mac screen. According to Apple, the touch sensor is embedded directly into the panel rather than being an additional layer on top, which is designed to reduce response time. Scrolling, zooming with a two-finger gesture, and moving windows work as expected; macOS automatically translates touch inputs into clicks in existing apps. Things get even more interesting for creatives: In Pixelmator Pro, you can draw directly on the screen; in Logic Pro, musicians can play a virtual multi-finger keyboard; and Final Cut Pro users can mark cut points with a tap. App developers can also test iOS and iPadOS apps for touch compatibility directly on the MacBook Pro display. A redesigned hinge mechanism is intended to keep the display stable when tapped, preventing the screen from wobbling. For those who’ve been following the pre-release coverage: We had already announced this exact device in advance as a MacBook Pro with an OLED touchscreen ; Apple has now confirmed the rumors with its own name and release timeline. Dynamic Island, previously seen on the iPhone, is now coming to the Mac. It serves as a launch point for Spotlight, displays Live Activities, and acts as the docking point for Siri AI. Users can use it to ask questions, answer a call, or control music playback without moving the mouse pointer. Anyone already familiar with the iPhone 18 Pro —on which Dynamic Island has been running since September—will recognize this interaction pattern. On the software side, the MacBook Pro runs macOS 27 “Golden Gate.” Siri AI is said to be significantly more conversational and able to access personal context from messages, emails, and photos, though with daily usage limits for features that run on Apple’s servers. In Safari, Apple Intelligence automatically organizes tabs by topic, and in the future, shortcuts can be easily created using descriptions. Under the hood are the M5 Pro and M5 Max, which Apple claims are the most powerful chips ever in a Pro notebook. Both feature a Neural Accelerator in each GPU core, designed to speed up AI tasks such as running a coding assistant locally. According to Apple, the M5 Max allows language models with several hundred billion parameters to run entirely on the device—a claim aimed primarily at AI developers and VFX studios. While the chip generation is familiar, the new chassis comes as a surprise: The 14-inch model now weighs 1.36 kilograms, while the 16-inch model weighs 1.81 kilograms. According to Apple, this is made possible by the space-saving design of the OLED panel compared to Mini-LED; the 14-inch model weighs about 225 grams less than its predecessor. Thanks to narrower bezels, the screen sizes have increased slightly to 14.2 and 16.3 inches, respectively. Battery life is expected to remain at up to 24 hours despite the thinner enclosure, and a redesigned thermal management system is intended to efficiently dissipate heat away from the display. The laptop features three Thunderbolt 5 ports, HDMI, an SDXC card slot, MagSafe, and a headphone jack. With the M5 Pro, up to three external displays can be used in addition to the built-in screen; with the M5 Max, the number increases to four. RAM capacity goes up to 128 GB, and flash storage up to 16 TB—both significantly more than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with the M6 chip , released at the same time, which lacks a touchscreen and features a Mini-LED display. The six-speaker system features new woofers for 50 percent more bass and redesigned tweeters. A new feature is dedicated audio tuning for use with the lid closed while connected to an external monitor. For video production, there’s support for Genlock, which synchronizes the display’s refresh rate with the recording from a compatible camera—a feature that’s likely to be of particular interest on virtual production sets. The exact RAM limit depends on the selected chip configuration; Apple specifies 128 GB only for the top-of-the-line M5 Max model. All information is based on manufacturer specifications; alternative configurations can be customized individually through Apple. In the U.S., the 14-inch model with the M5 Pro starts at $2,899, while the 16-inch model with the M5 Pro starts at $3,399. With the M5 Max, prices are $4,499 for the smaller model and $4,799 for the larger one. Apple did not specify concrete euro prices for Germany in the press release, but they should become available when sales begin on the Apple Online Store . Experience shows that German prices are higher than the straight dollar exchange rate due to VAT and rounding, but this can only be reliably confirmed once the German pricing page goes live. Pre-orders have been available since October 28 via the Apple Store app and apple.com, with shipments beginning Friday, November 6, 2026, initially in 30 countries. Those who opt for the more affordable, non-touch option will find an alternative in the MacBook Pro with the M6 chip —unveiled at the same time—which offers the new display at no extra cost. The iMac with the M6 chip and the 2026 iPad mini —featuring an OLED display for the first time—are also part of this week’s product lineup. For years, the idea of a touchscreen on the MacBook Pro sounded like a rumor that would never come true; Apple had publicly described touch on the Mac as impractical on multiple occasions. The fact that the PROLED-XDR model is now launching anyway—and sits right alongside a standard, non-touch M6 MacBook Pro in the lineup—shows just how cautiously Apple is proceeding. Those with no interest in touch don’t have to switch and won’t pay any extra for it. So who will really benefit from this device? The strongest arguments come not from the touchscreen, but from the display itself: 2,000 nits of SDR brightness and a 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio are figures no laptop display has ever achieved, and Adobe RGB in addition to P3 is a real step forward for photographers and graphic designers. Whether the touchscreen offers any real benefit in everyday use depends heavily on your own workflow. Those who work in Logic Pro, Pixelmator Pro, or Final Cut will likely take to it quickly. Those who primarily type and click with a mouse on their Mac, on the other hand, are getting a significantly more expensive display whose additional feature goes unused. The premium over a comparably equipped MacBook Pro with the M6 ranges roughly between $400 and $900, depending on the configuration. This isn’t a must-buy, but rather a clear niche product: content creators, colorists, and musicians who use the display as a tool will find this to be their best Mac display yet. For everyone else, the M6 MacBook Pro remains the more sensible choice. PROLED XDR is Apple’s new name for the tandem OLED display in the MacBook Pro. It replaces the previous Mini-LED display, called Liquid Retina XDR, and, according to Apple, offers up to 2,000 nits of brightness and a contrast ratio of 10,000,000:1. Yes, it’s the first MacBook Pro—and the first Mac ever—with a touchscreen. The touch sensor is built directly into the display and supports gestures such as scrolling, zooming, and dragging. Yes, the 14-inch MacBook Pro with the M6 chip, introduced on October 27, 2026, remains in the lineup without a touchscreen and with a Mini-LED display, at a lower starting price. In the U.S., the 14-inch model with the M5 Pro starts at $2,899, and the 16-inch model with the M5 Max starts at $4,799. Apple has not yet released German prices in euros. Pre-orders have been open since October 28, 2026, via the Apple Online Store, and shipping begins on November 6, 2026, in 30 countries, including Germany. sources.title: Apple unveils groundbreaking MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display - MacDailyNews
passages: Apple today introduced the all-new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, featuring breakthrough tandem OLED technology that delivers game-changing front-of-screen performance.
The Dynamic Island now comes to Mac, serving as the home for Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI.
An enhanced six-speaker sound system now provides 50 percent deeper bass and remarkable sound clarity for even more immersive audio.
It is available to pre-order starting today, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.
“PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display.
PROLED XDR offers pros a super-wide color gamut with P3 and now Adobe RGB — critical for workflows in photography and design — along with notably wider coverage in green and cyan ranges.
2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading.
Cutting-edge factory calibration ensures luminance, white point, and color gamut are precisely aligned with standard targets.
Both color spaces are accessible within a single default preset, streamlining pro workflows and making it seamless to switch between them.
With Pixelmator Pro, creators can interact with their designs directly on the canvas, making use of the fully interactive display to draw, paint, and select with even more fluidity.
In Logic Pro, musicians can play software instruments with a fully Multi-Touch polyphonic keyboard, along with tappable chord and drum pads onscreen.
And in Final Cut Pro, editors can use Touch to precisely mark ranges, drop clips directly into place, pinch to zoom in on a cut, and more.
And macOS makes the most of the graphics, memory, and machine learning capabilities of Apple silicon, so apps perform at incredible speed.
Additional configure-to-order options are available at apple.com/macbook-pro .
Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 provide fast, reliable wireless connectivity, and Touch ID enables a quick, easy, and secure login experience.
With its fast-charge capability, MacBook Pro can charge up to 50 percent in just 30 minutes.
In addition, storage is now configurable up to 16TB.

It is made with 55 percent recycled content overall,9 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure, 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery, and, in a first for Apple, 100 percent recycled tantalum in multiple capacitors.
It is manufactured with 45 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain.
As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based10 and designed to be recycled.
• With Apple Trade In, customers can trade in their current computer and get credit toward a new Mac.

Customers in the U.S. who shop at Apple using Apple Card can pay monthly at 0 percent APR when they choose to check out with Apple Card Monthly Installments, and they’ll get 3 percent Daily Cash back — all up front.

In addition to Touch built for macOS 27, MacBook Pro includes Siri AI, a profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal assistant; helpful Apple Intelligence features across apps; and an expansive set of improvements that make the Mac even more responsive and reliable.

Siri AI can draw on personal context to help pros find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps — all with groundbreaking privacy protections.

Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what’s on their display with Visual Intelligence by using a dedicated keyboard shortcut to get help with a specific item.
Pros can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type.
Updated system gesture APIs also enable developers to create intuitive experiences designed specifically for Touch.

These include everyday productivity and collaboration apps like Notion, Canva, Zoom, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook; powerful creative tools for photo and video editing like Adobe Lightroom and DaVinci Resolve; 3D modeling and animation apps like Blender, Maxon Cinema 4D, Maxon ZBrush, and Shapr3D; along with music apps like Algoriddim djay Pro.
The 14-inch MacBook Pro now weighs half a pound less at 3 pounds, while the 16-inch MacBook Pro weighs just 4 pounds — 0.7 pounds lighter than before.
Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos wraps users in immersive sound for music and movies, and studio-quality mics deliver clean, clear audio for calls, recordings, and voice commands.

And for the first time, dedicated audio tuning for closed-lid use delivers exceptional sound quality when MacBook Pro is connected to an external display, so users can enjoy a premium audio experience however they work.
And the touch sensor is built directly into the display panel — not layered on top of it — reducing latency so users feel like they’re touching the content itself.
Touch also introduces entirely new ways of working for pro users.
And these new ways to interact with MacBook Pro work in tandem with the keyboard shortcuts and trackpad gestures pros know and love.

In addition, a newly designed hinge provides greater stability while using Touch, and advanced video stabilization automatically smooths the camera feed in real time while using Touch on a video call.
• The Apple Pro Display Calibrator gives pros the ability to calibrate their display to specific targets.
• AppleCare delivers exceptional service and support, with flexible options for Apple users.
Both plans include coverage for accidents like drops and spills, battery replacement service, and priority support from Apple Experts.
For more information, visit apple.com/applecare .

passages: Apple today introduced the all-new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, featuring breakthrough tandem OLED technology that delivers game-changing front-of-screen performance. Available in 14- and 16-inch models, MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display offers a visual experience unlike any other, transforming pro workflows with up to 2000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness, an industry-leading 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio for exceptional detail, a 120Hz variable refresh rate, and a wider color gamut covering both P3 and Adobe RGB for brilliant colors. The new MacBook Pro also introduces intuitive Touch capabilities on the Mac for the first time, opening up a whole new dimension for pros to interact with their content, from manipulating 3D models to playing musical instruments onscreen. The Dynamic Island now comes to Mac, serving as the home for Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI. And with up to 24 hours of battery life in thinner and much lighter 3- and 4-pound designs, MacBook Pro is more portable than ever, empowering pros to take their work wherever inspiration strikes.3 Featuring M5 Pro and M5 Max, Apple’s most powerful chips ever built for a pro laptop, along with up to 128GB of unified memory and now up to 16TB of blazing-fast storage, the new MacBook Pro delivers speed and capability for the most demanding workflows. An enhanced six-speaker sound system now provides 50 percent deeper bass and remarkable sound clarity for even more immersive audio. And Thunderbolt 5 and a wide array of connectivity, a 12MP Center Stage camera, studio-quality mics, and the power of macOS 27 with Apple Intelligence and Siri AI complete the MacBook Pro experience. It is available to pre-order starting today, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.

“The new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is a monumental step forward for the Mac,” said Johny Srouji, Apple’s chief hardware officer, in a statement. “PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display. It pairs state-of-the-art tandem OLED technology with advanced algorithms in our display engine to deliver the kind of visual fidelity pros have been dreaming of. And with the magic of Touch coming to MacBook Pro, combined with the game-changing performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, we’ve created a whole new way for pros to interact with their content, taking their workflows to a completely new level. The new MacBook Pro is the result of the deep integration between Apple silicon, hardware, and software, and there’s simply nothing else like it.”
PROLED XDR: The World’s Best Display in a Pro Laptop

The new MacBook Pro debuts the PROLED XDR display, which uses tandem OLED technology and advances it with breakthrough innovations in every layer, advanced algorithms in the display engine, and a state-of-the-art factory calibration process to deliver Extreme Dynamic Range (XDR) and stunning visual fidelity. With exceptional brightness, striking contrast, and vivid true-to-life colors, PROLED XDR offers the ultimate front-of-screen performance, enabling a new level of visual acuity and precision for content creators, photographers, colorists, and designers who need a reference-caliber display on the go.

PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display, delivering true-to-life color and unparalleled brightness and contrast. The PROLED XDR display offers tandem OLED technology unlike any other, with deep innovations in its layers that keep brightness and grayscale uniform across the entire display, while minimizing internal reflections common in traditional OLED designs. It’s all backed by advanced algorithms in the display engine that precisely control each pixel in real time, plus a meticulous manufacturing process and precise calibration of every panel for consistency from display to display.
The Ultimate Display for Color-Critical Workflows

PROLED XDR offers pros a super-wide color gamut with P3 and now Adobe RGB — critical for workflows in photography and design — along with notably wider coverage in green and cyan ranges. This results in more than 80 percent Rec. 2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading. Cutting-edge factory calibration ensures luminance, white point, and color gamut are precisely aligned with standard targets. Both color spaces are accessible within a single default preset, streamlining pro workflows and making it seamless to switch between them. With the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, pros have a portable reference display on the go.

MacBook Pro features Touch for the first time, bringing pros a whole new way to interact with their content. Crafted specifically for the Mac, every touch interaction feels incredibly responsive and refined. Everyday tasks are simple and intuitive, allowing users to scroll through a webpage with a natural swipe; pinch to zoom in on a photo; drag and drop slides from one presentation to another; and double-tap a window to fill the screen, or flick to tile it into place. And the touch sensor is built directly into the display panel — not layered on top of it — reducing latency so users feel like they’re touching the content itself.

Touch also introduces entirely new ways of working for pro users. Graphic designers can now use the entire display as their canvas, no longer constrained by the area of the trackpad when drawing; musicians can play software instruments right onscreen; and app developers can test how Touch performs in their iOS and iPadOS apps directly on the MacBook Pro display. And these new ways to interact with MacBook Pro work in tandem with the keyboard shortcuts and trackpad gestures pros know and love. In addition, a newly designed hinge provides greater stability while using Touch, and advanced video stabilization automatically smooths the camera feed in real time while using Touch on a video call.

Apple apps are optimized for the new MacBook Pro, and many existing apps work with Touch right away, because macOS automatically translates touches into clicks. Updated system gesture APIs also enable developers to create intuitive experiences designed specifically for Touch. And a wide range of third-party apps that pros rely on every day will also take advantage of Touch on the new MacBook Pro, bringing new ways to interact with their favorite tools and workflows. These include everyday productivity and collaboration apps like Notion, Canva, Zoom, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook; powerful creative tools for photo and video editing like Adobe Lightroom and DaVinci Resolve; 3D modeling and animation apps like Blender, Maxon Cinema 4D, Maxon ZBrush, and Shapr3D; along with music apps like Algoriddim djay Pro.

The new MacBook Pro is thinner and significantly lighter for even better portability. The 14-inch MacBook Pro now weighs half a pound less at 3 pounds, while the 16-inch MacBook Pro weighs just 4 pounds — 0.7 pounds lighter than before. Both models feature a slimmer design enabled by OLED’s more efficient display stack, with the 16-inch model nearly a millimeter thinner and the 14-inch model half a millimeter thinner.

With slimmer display borders, the 16-inch display grows to 16.3 inches, while the 14-inch display delivers a more portable 14.2-inch design. And a completely redesigned thermal architecture enables the same incredible sustained performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, even in a lighter design, while redirecting warm air away from the display.

The industry-leading six-speaker audio system in the new MacBook Pro features an all-new woofer design that provides 50 percent deeper bass and all-new tweeters that shape sound dispersion for remarkable clarity. Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos wraps users in immersive sound for music and movies, and studio-quality mics deliver clean, clear audio for calls, recordings, and voice commands. And for the first time, dedicated audio tuning for closed-lid use delivers exceptional sound quality when MacBook Pro is connected to an external display, so users can enjoy a premium audio experience however they work.

The new MacBook Pro packs features for the most demanding users. The PROLED XDR display offers calibration and industry-standard reference modes in a portable form factor, making MacBook Pro an indispensable tool for filmmaking, design, and even medical imaging. And macOS makes the most of the graphics, memory, and machine learning capabilities of Apple silicon, so apps perform at incredible speed.

• The Apple Pro Display Calibrator gives pros the ability to calibrate their display to specific targets. In addition, pros can take advantage of industry-standard reference modes for cinematic standards, photography, print, design, and more. And with new DICOM medical imaging reference modes, the display can be used today to review medical images with outstanding grayscale accuracy and contrast when used for nondiagnostic reviews, research, and educational purposes.
• Through Apple Color Matching Function 2026 , the PROLED XDR display delivers a seamless, consistent visual experience when paired with iPhone 18 Pro or Studio Display XDR.

• With support for genlock , MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display synchronizes a display’s refresh rate with a camera’s capture to minimize ghosting, tearing, and other visual artifacts when filming, making it highly valuable for virtual productions and on-set work.8

• Apple Creator Studio opens up new ways to create on MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, optimizing for Touch alongside the precision of the keyboard and trackpad. With Pixelmator Pro, creators can interact with their designs directly on the canvas, making use of the fully interactive display to draw, paint, and select with even more fluidity. In Logic Pro, musicians can play software instruments with a fully Multi-Touch polyphonic keyboard, along with tappable chord and drum pads onscreen. And in Final Cut Pro, editors can use Touch to precisely mark ranges, drop clips directly into place, pinch to zoom in on a cut, and more.

The new MacBook Pro includes three Thunderbolt 5 ports, HDMI, an SDXC card slot, MagSafe, and a headphone jack. In addition to the PROLED XDR display, it supports up to three external displays with M5 Pro and up to four with M5 Max. Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 provide fast, reliable wireless connectivity, and Touch ID enables a quick, easy, and secure login experience. With its fast-charge capability, MacBook Pro can charge up to 50 percent in just 30 minutes. In addition, storage is now configurable up to 16TB.

The new MacBook Pro comes to life with macOS 27. In addition to Touch built for macOS 27, MacBook Pro includes Siri AI, a profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal assistant; helpful Apple Intelligence features across apps; and an expansive set of improvements that make the Mac even more responsive and reliable. Siri AI can draw on personal context to help pros find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps — all with groundbreaking privacy protections. Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what’s on their display with Visual Intelligence by using a dedicated keyboard shortcut to get help with a specific item. Pros can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type.

Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful. In Safari, it powers new tools that automatically organize a user’s tabs into topics; notify them of website changes, like product restocks or price drops; and enable the creation of custom extensions based on a description. Pros can also easily create an automation in Shortcuts by simply describing it, or tap into intelligent photo editing tools in the Photos app. Features users already rely on get even better with improvements to performance and search. Refinements to Liquid Glass deliver an even more focused and approachable experience. A new slider in Settings gives users the option to personalize Liquid Glass, adjusting it anywhere from ultraclear to fully tinted to match their preference, and app icons are sharper and more defined.
MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and the Environment

The new MacBook Pro was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 55 percent recycled content overall,9 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure, 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery, and, in a first for Apple, 100 percent recycled tantalum in multiple capacitors. It is manufactured with 45 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain. extraction.body: On October 28, 2026, Apple unveiled the MacBook Pro with a PROLED XDR display, the first Mac ever to feature a touchscreen. The new tandem OLED panel replaces the previous Mini-LED display, offering up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness and a contrast ratio of 10,000,000:1. Featuring the M5 Pro or M5 Max, Dynamic Island, and up to 24 hours of battery life, the device goes on sale starting November 6, with prices in the U.S. starting at $2,899. With PROLED XDR, Apple is introducing a new designation for the displays on its Pro laptops. Technically, it’s a tandem OLED panel: Two stacked light-emitting layers work together to produce greater brightness and more uniform illumination than a single OLED panel could achieve. Apple cites up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness in SDR and HDR, as well as a contrast ratio of 10,000,000:1. By comparison, the previous Liquid Retina XDR display with Mini-LED backlighting achieved 1,600 nits of peak HDR brightness and a contrast ratio of 1,000,000:1. In addition, there is a wider color gamut that now covers Adobe RGB in addition to P3; both color spaces are included in a single preset profile. For video professionals, the Rec. 2020 coverage of over 80 percent is likely to be of particular interest. The variable refresh rate ranges from 10 to 120 Hz; depending on the content, the system automatically switches between power-saving mode and smooth display. Anti-glare nano-textured glass remains available as an optional extra. 42 years after the introduction of the first Macintosh, Apple is bringing touch control to a Mac screen. According to Apple, the touch sensor is embedded directly into the panel rather than being an additional layer on top, which is designed to reduce response time. Scrolling, zooming with a two-finger gesture, and moving windows work as expected; macOS automatically translates touch inputs into clicks in existing apps. Things get even more interesting for creatives: In Pixelmator Pro, you can draw directly on the screen; in Logic Pro, musicians can play a virtual multi-finger keyboard; and Final Cut Pro users can mark cut points with a tap. App developers can also test iOS and iPadOS apps for touch compatibility directly on the MacBook Pro display. A redesigned hinge mechanism is intended to keep the display stable when tapped, preventing the screen from wobbling. For those who’ve been following the pre-release coverage: We had already announced this exact device in advance as a MacBook Pro with an OLED touchscreen ; Apple has now confirmed the rumors with its own name and release timeline. Dynamic Island, previously seen on the iPhone, is now coming to the Mac. It serves as a launch point for Spotlight, displays Live Activities, and acts as the docking point for Siri AI. Users can use it to ask questions, answer a call, or control music playback without moving the mouse pointer. Anyone already familiar with the iPhone 18 Pro —on which Dynamic Island has been running since September—will recognize this interaction pattern. On the software side, the MacBook Pro runs macOS 27 “Golden Gate.” Siri AI is said to be significantly more conversational and able to access personal context from messages, emails, and photos, though with daily usage limits for features that run on Apple’s servers. In Safari, Apple Intelligence automatically organizes tabs by topic, and in the future, shortcuts can be easily created using descriptions. Under the hood are the M5 Pro and M5 Max, which Apple claims are the most powerful chips ever in a Pro notebook. Both feature a Neural Accelerator in each GPU core, designed to speed up AI tasks such as running a coding assistant locally. According to Apple, the M5 Max allows language models with several hundred billion parameters to run entirely on the device—a claim aimed primarily at AI developers and VFX studios. While the chip generation is familiar, the new chassis comes as a surprise: The 14-inch model now weighs 1.36 kilograms, while the 16-inch model weighs 1.81 kilograms. According to Apple, this is made possible by the space-saving design of the OLED panel compared to Mini-LED; the 14-inch model weighs about 225 grams less than its predecessor. Thanks to narrower bezels, the screen sizes have increased slightly to 14.2 and 16.3 inches, respectively. Battery life is expected to remain at up to 24 hours despite the thinner enclosure, and a redesigned thermal management system is intended to efficiently dissipate heat away from the display. The laptop features three Thunderbolt 5 ports, HDMI, an SDXC card slot, MagSafe, and a headphone jack. With the M5 Pro, up to three external displays can be used in addition to the built-in screen; with the M5 Max, the number increases to four. RAM capacity goes up to 128 GB, and flash storage up to 16 TB—both significantly more than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with the M6 chip , released at the same time, which lacks a touchscreen and features a Mini-LED display. The six-speaker system features new woofers for 50 percent more bass and redesigned tweeters. A new feature is dedicated audio tuning for use with the lid closed while connected to an external monitor. For video production, there’s support for Genlock, which synchronizes the display’s refresh rate with the recording from a compatible camera—a feature that’s likely to be of particular interest on virtual production sets. The exact RAM limit depends on the selected chip configuration; Apple specifies 128 GB only for the top-of-the-line M5 Max model. All information is based on manufacturer specifications; alternative configurations can be customized individually through Apple. In the U.S., the 14-inch model with the M5 Pro starts at $2,899, while the 16-inch model with the M5 Pro starts at $3,399. With the M5 Max, prices are $4,499 for the smaller model and $4,799 for the larger one. Apple did not specify concrete euro prices for Germany in the press release, but they should become available when sales begin on the Apple Online Store . Experience shows that German prices are higher than the straight dollar exchange rate due to VAT and rounding, but this can only be reliably confirmed once the German pricing page goes live. passages: On October 28, 2026, Apple unveiled the MacBook Pro with a PROLED XDR display, the first Mac ever to feature a touchscreen. The new tandem OLED panel replaces the previous Mini-LED display, offering up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness and a contrast ratio of 10,000,000:1. Featuring the M5 Pro or M5 Max, Dynamic Island, and up to 24 hours of battery life, the device goes on sale starting November 6, with prices in the U.S. starting at $2,899.

With PROLED XDR, Apple is introducing a new designation for the displays on its Pro laptops. Technically, it’s a tandem OLED panel: Two stacked light-emitting layers work together to produce greater brightness and more uniform illumination than a single OLED panel could achieve. Apple cites up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness in SDR and HDR, as well as a contrast ratio of 10,000,000:1. By comparison, the previous Liquid Retina XDR display with Mini-LED backlighting achieved 1,600 nits of peak HDR brightness and a contrast ratio of 1,000,000:1.

In addition, there is a wider color gamut that now covers Adobe RGB in addition to P3; both color spaces are included in a single preset profile. For video professionals, the Rec. 2020 coverage of over 80 percent is likely to be of particular interest. The variable refresh rate ranges from 10 to 120 Hz; depending on the content, the system automatically switches between power-saving mode and smooth display. Anti-glare nano-textured glass remains available as an optional extra.

42 years after the introduction of the first Macintosh, Apple is bringing touch control to a Mac screen. According to Apple, the touch sensor is embedded directly into the panel rather than being an additional layer on top, which is designed to reduce response time. Scrolling, zooming with a two-finger gesture, and moving windows work as expected; macOS automatically translates touch inputs into clicks in existing apps.

Things get even more interesting for creatives: In Pixelmator Pro, you can draw directly on the screen; in Logic Pro, musicians can play a virtual multi-finger keyboard; and Final Cut Pro users can mark cut points with a tap. App developers can also test iOS and iPadOS apps for touch compatibility directly on the MacBook Pro display. A redesigned hinge mechanism is intended to keep the display stable when tapped, preventing the screen from wobbling.

For those who’ve been following the pre-release coverage: We had already announced this exact device in advance as a MacBook Pro with an OLED touchscreen ; Apple has now confirmed the rumors with its own name and release timeline.

Dynamic Island, previously seen on the iPhone, is now coming to the Mac. It serves as a launch point for Spotlight, displays Live Activities, and acts as the docking point for Siri AI. Users can use it to ask questions, answer a call, or control music playback without moving the mouse pointer. Anyone already familiar with the iPhone 18 Pro —on which Dynamic Island has been running since September—will recognize this interaction pattern.

On the software side, the MacBook Pro runs macOS 27 “Golden Gate.” Siri AI is said to be significantly more conversational and able to access personal context from messages, emails, and photos, though with daily usage limits for features that run on Apple’s servers. In Safari, Apple Intelligence automatically organizes tabs by topic, and in the future, shortcuts can be easily created using descriptions.

Under the hood are the M5 Pro and M5 Max, which Apple claims are the most powerful chips ever in a Pro notebook. Both feature a Neural Accelerator in each GPU core, designed to speed up AI tasks such as running a coding assistant locally. According to Apple, the M5 Max allows language models with several hundred billion parameters to run entirely on the device—a claim aimed primarily at AI developers and VFX studios.

While the chip generation is familiar, the new chassis comes as a surprise: The 14-inch model now weighs 1.36 kilograms, while the 16-inch model weighs 1.81 kilograms. According to Apple, this is made possible by the space-saving design of the OLED panel compared to Mini-LED; the 14-inch model weighs about 225 grams less than its predecessor. Thanks to narrower bezels, the screen sizes have increased slightly to 14.2 and 16.3 inches, respectively. Battery life is expected to remain at up to 24 hours despite the thinner enclosure, and a redesigned thermal management system is intended to efficiently dissipate heat away from the display.

It pairs state-of-the-art tandem OLED technology with advanced algorithms in our display engine to deliver the kind of visual fidelity pros have been dreaming of.

2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading.

Siri AI can draw on personal context to help pros find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps — all with groundbreaking privacy protections.

Touch also introduces entirely new ways of working for pro users.

Graphic designers can now use the entire display as their canvas, no longer constrained by the area of the trackpad when drawing; musicians can play software instruments right onscreen; and app developers can test how Touch performs in their iOS and iPadOS apps directly on the MacBook Pro display.

Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 provide fast, reliable wireless connectivity, and Touch ID enables a quick, easy, and secure login experience.

Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos wraps users in immersive sound for music and movies, and studio-quality mics deliver clean, clear audio for calls, recordings, and voice commands.

As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 10 and designed to be recycled.
Both deliver phenomenal single- and multithreaded CPU performance, along with faster unified memory, giving users blazing speed for the most demanding workflows.

M5 Pro offers game-changing performance for scientists, engineers, software developers, and creative pros tackling intensive projects, accelerating everything from compiling code and running AI tasks to sequencing DNA and editing multiple streams of 8K ProRes video.
M5 Max is built for users who want to push the limits even further, including 3D VFX artists, AI developers, and film composers.
